name: PaperFolding-Benchmark
description: PaperFolding-Benchmark evaluates models' spatial and procedural reasoning by asking them to predict outcomes of paper-folding operations (e.g., crease patterns, hole positions, or final configurations) given folding instructions or intermediate states. Tasks typically require geometric reasoning and visualization skills and may be presented as multiple-choice or generative problems.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset for spatial reasoning tasks with limited but growing use in specialized benchmarking.
